method.tool: discover_suppliers (packages/core/src/tools/stubs.ts), max_results 8, read_pages 2, run live against You.com
method.matching: candidate host or name contains a supplier alias (e.g. Merck = merckgroup / sigmaaldrich / milliporesigma)
method.precision: judged by nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B: manufacturer or distributor of this material = relevant; precision@k = relevant / k
method.gmp_evidence: complianceSignals() on snippet + page excerpt, or page signals, includes GMP / US DMF / CEP
method.scout_rule: scout instructions: keep only candidates whose evidence mentions the substance AND a GMP/DMF/CEP signal
method.raw_replay: same queries sent straight to You.com search (count 12) with no host filter / dedup / truncation

query_template: `${substance} ${grade with / replaced by space} GMP manufacturer DMF CEP`
`${substance} ${first two compendia} pharmaceutical grade supplier` (replaced by the caller's free-text query when one is passed; max 2 queries)

other: read top read_pages supplier_site pages via You.com contents and regex compliance claims
